title: FORMAT ( 1234.567, "#,0.00" ) is "1,234.57": extra decimals are rounded

source.quote: Use comma as thousand separator and dot as decimal separator
source.supports: the example shows FORMAT( 1234.567, "#,0.00", "en-US" ) as 1,234.57; the model culture is en-US

source.quote: round the number to as many decimal places as there are zeros
source.supports: more digits than zero placeholders are rounded

derivation: The page shows the result with the locale "en-US" given; here the locale comes from the model, which is en-US. 1234.567 rounds to 1234.57 and gets a thousand separator.
